name: UIverse
description: Huge open-source library of animated CSS/Tailwind UI elements (buttons, loaders, cards, switches) made by the community. Copy-paste HTML/CSS/Tailwind snippets, no build step required.

name: Aceternity UI
description: Copy-paste React + Tailwind + Framer Motion components with heavy animation: animated hero sections, glowing cards, background beams, text reveals. Popular for landing pages.

name: Magic UI
description: 50+ animated, open-source components built for marketing/landing pages, designed to pair with shadcn/ui. Includes marquees, particles, animated beams, dock menus.

name: HyperUI
description: Free, open-source Tailwind CSS component library covering marketing and application UI; not all animated but a solid base for building animated variants on top of.

name: Animista
description: Interactive CSS animation generator — pick an effect (entrance, exit, attention seekers, background), tweak timing/easing on sliders, and export ready-made @keyframes CSS.

name: Framer Motion Examples (Motion.dev)
description: Official docs/examples for Motion (formerly Framer Motion), the most widely used animation library for React/JS. Great source of real animated component patterns and code.

name: React Bits
description: Animated React components (text effects, backgrounds, buttons, loaders) with plain CSS, Tailwind, or Framer Motion/GSAP variants — pick the stack you want and copy the code.

name: Tailwind CSS Buttons
description: Focused collection of animated/hover-effect buttons built purely in Tailwind CSS classes, easy to copy into any Tailwind project.

name: Cuberto (Awwwards-style inspiration)
description: Agency portfolio full of award-winning, heavily-animated site builds — not copy-paste components, but excellent reference for what's achievable with GSAP/WebGL-driven UI motion.

name: shadcn/ui
description: Not animation-first, but the de-facto base component set (accordion, dialog, tooltip) that most animated component libraries above (Magic UI, Aceternity) are built to extend.

name: Codrops (Tympanus)
description: Long-running design/dev blog with in-depth, source-included tutorials for advanced animated UI — page transitions, WebGL effects, scroll-driven interactions.

name: Lottie Files
description: Marketplace/library of lightweight vector animations (Lottie JSON) exported from After Effects — drop-in animated icons, loaders, and illustrations for any web/app stack.
